releaseNotes:
Re-home X after mixing before serving the drink

The mixing phase shakes the cabinet hard enough to knock the X
carriage off its home reference. RETURNING_TO_IDLE previously moved
X straight to idle on the assumption it was still at product/home
position. Now, after Y homes, we read SENSOR_X_HOME and re-home X if
it no longer reads active, then re-confirm before the serve move.

Re-home is conditional (skipped when X is still home) and proceeds to
serve regardless of the confirm result, matching awaitYHomeBeforeXMove:
stranding the customer behind a closed door is worse than a soft
collision the firmware recovers from.
